question: Who among the following received the 53rd Dadasaheb Phalke Award in 2023 for her lifetime achievement in Indian cinema?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Waheeda Rehman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Veteran actress Waheeda Rehman was honored with the prestigious **53rd Dadasaheb Phalke Award** in 2023.
 
• The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest award in cinema, presented annually by the Government of India.
 
• Waheeda Rehman has had a prolific career in Indian cinema spanning over six decades, known for her exemplary performances in films such as "Pyaasa", "Guide", and "Khamoshi".
 
• She was recognized for her **lifetime achievement** in contributing significantly to Indian cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award:**

 
 
• The award is named after Dhundiraj Govind Phalke, revered as the 'Father of Indian Cinema'.
 
• It was instituted in 1969, and the first recipient was actress Devika Rani.
 
• The award includes a Swarna Kamal (Golden Lotus) medallion, a shawl, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Waheeda Rehman's Career:**
 
 
• She began her career with the Telugu film "Rojulu Marayi" and gained prominence in Hindi cinema with Guru Dutt's "CID".
 
• Waheeda has worked with iconic filmmakers like Satyajit Ray, Raj Khosla, and Yash Chopra.
 
• She is also a recipient of several other awards, including the Padma Bhushan and the Padma Shri.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Award:**
 
 
• The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is a recognition of outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema.
 
• It is considered one of the most coveted honors in the Indian film industry.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Recipients:**
 
 
• Previous recipients include legends like Raj Kapoor, Lata Mangeshkar, Amitabh Bachchan, and Rajinikanth.
 
• The award showcases the diverse talents and contributions of individuals across different facets of Indian cinema.
